instructions:
GeneXus Knowledge Base MCP server. Reads and writes go through the GeneXus SDK (or the catalogued legacy driver), never file parsing. Route by intent:
- Start every session with genexus_whoami (KB context, version, health, next steps). No KB open: genexus_kb action=open path=<KB root> (starts its Worker). Already open or declared: action=list, then action=select (session only).
- Find objects: genexus_query (name:"X" exact, type:, usedby:, parent:). Page through every object: genexus_list_objects. Find code text: genexus_search_source.
- Read: genexus_read without part returns the complete object in one call. Before a version-checked edit, read the part you will change (part=Source, Rules, ...) and pass its versionToken as baseVersion. Compact snapshot: genexus_inspect.
- Understand before changing: genexus_analyze mode=context (360-degree task context in one call), genexus_object_context (callers, callees, data model), genexus_impact (affected set and rebuild order).
- Change code: genexus_edit with dryRun=true first, then the same call without it. Variables: genexus_variable. Structure of Transactions/SDTs: genexus_structure. New objects: genexus_create. WorkWithPlus: genexus_apply_pattern.
- Build or validate: genexus_lifecycle; long operations return an operationId, poll with action=status target=op:<id>.
- Something looks wrong: genexus_doctor.
Pass kb=<alias> when more than one KB is open. Full guidance and schema for any tool: resources/read genexus://kb/tool-help/<tool>.
